title: How Predictive Maintenance and Digitalization Are Reshaping the Industry
summary: The aviation aftermarket is entering a new era. As operators face increasing pressure to improve reliability, control costs, and minimize downtime, the world of Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) is being transformed by predictive technologies, digital platforms, and engineered solutions.
body_text: The aviation aftermarket is entering a new era. As operators face increasing pressure to improve reliability, control costs, and minimize downtime, the world of Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) is being transformed by predictive technologies, digital platforms, and engineered solutions . With 2025 on the horizon, understanding these shifts is critical for fleet managers, lessors, and airline executives alike. Here’s a look at the top aviation MRO trends for 2025 —and how forward-looking providers like AerSale are helping drive the industry forward. 1. Predictive Maintenance Is No Longer Optional In the past, operators relied on scheduled maintenance and reactive repairs to manage fleet health. In 2025, predictive maintenance is taking center stage. Leveraging real-time data and analytics, airlines can now anticipate component failures before they happen , reducing AOG events and improving dispatch reliability. Key benefits include: Lower unscheduled maintenance costs Improved parts planning and inventory management Increased aircraft uptime and availability 2. Digital MRO Solutions Are Accelerating Efficiency Digitalization is impacting every step of the MRO lifecycle—from maintenance tracking to records management to quality assurance. In 2025, expect increased investment in: Mobile MRO tools and paperless work orders Digital twins for aircraft and components AI-driven task scheduling and workforce optimization These technologies not only reduce human error and improve traceability but also streamline compliance and regulatory reporting , saving time and money across the board. At AerSale, we are integrating digital tools across our MRO network—from mobile inspection systems to digital customer portals that keep operators informed in real-time. 3. Used Serviceable Material (USM) Is Gaining Ground With supply chain bottlenecks and rising OEM lead times, used serviceable material (USM) is emerging as a key pillar in modern MRO strategies. By incorporating certified USM into maintenance plans, operators benefit from: Lower material costs Shorter turnaround times Sustainable reuse of high-value assets As one of the industry’s leading providers of USM, AerSale pairs MRO services with in-house parts support , giving customers a one-stop solution for cost-effective, high-quality repairs. 4. Engineered Repairs and DER Capabilities Are in High Demand OEM parts pricing continues to rise, and operators are increasingly seeking engineered alternatives to expensive replacements. In 2025, DER (Designated Engineering Representative) repairs will play a major role in cost containment strategies. AerSale’s in-house engineering team is actively developing custom repair solutions and FAA-approved modifications that help our customers extend component life without compromising performance or safety. Our approach blends innovation with regulatory expertise , helping airlines navigate today’s economic challenges with smarter, more sustainable MRO strategies. 5. ESG and Sustainability Are Driving Decisions Sustainability isn’t just a buzzword—it’s a core consideration for airlines in 2025. From reducing carbon emissions to embracing circular economy practices, the MRO sector is being reshaped by environmental, social, and governance (ESG) goals. Digital maintenance platforms, USM integration, and predictive monitoring all contribute to a more resource-efficient MRO operation. AerSale’s focus on asset reuse, green disassembly, and life-extension engineering is helping customers meet ESG benchmarks while improving their bottom line. Looking Ahead As 2025 unfolds, the convergence of digital innovation, predictive intelligence, and engineered efficiency will continue to redefine the MRO landscape. Operators that embrace these trends will not only stay competitive—they’ll lead the next wave of aviation excellence. At AerSale , we’re proud to support our customers with future-ready MRO solutions that combine data, design, and decades of expertise Let’s Talk MRO 2025 Need help navigating the latest aviation MRO trends? Connect with AerSale to learn how our integrated MRO, USM, and engineering solutions can support your fleet’s future.

title: Wabash Redefines Trailer Accessibility with Trailers as a Service
summary: Wabash (NYSE: WNC), a leader in end-to-end supply chain solutions, today announced new Trailers as a Service (TaaS)℠ category offerings, designed to transform how trailer capacity is sourced, managed and deployed across North America.The TaaS portfolio introduces two flagship solutions, TaaS Pools and TaaS Plus, each designed to solve distinct...
body_text: Trailers as a Service (TaaS) Wabash (NYSE: WNC), a leader in end-to-end supply chain solutions, today announced new Trailers as a Service (TaaS)℠ category offerings, designed to transform how trailer capacity is sourced, managed and deployed across North America. The TaaS portfolio introduces two flagship solutions, TaaS Pools and TaaS Plus, each designed to solve distinct challenges facing shippers, 3PLs and carriers. Together, these offerings deliver the flexibility, scalability, and visibility needed in today’s supply chain without the long-term cost and risk of trailer ownership. TaaS Pools provides shippers with a universal, service-provider–agnostic trailer pool that replaces the complexity of managing fragmented pools across different partners. Instead of sourcing and maintaining separate pockets of capacity, shippers gain access to a nationwide pool of trailers positioned to support their operations. The program reduces dwell, improves dock efficiency, and ensures predictable, consistent trailer availability. Every trailer in the pool is supported by Wabash FleetCare for maintenance and compliance, giving customers confidence that equipment is always road-ready. TaaS Plus is designed for 3PLs and brokers that want to operate more like asset carriers without the capital requirements of owning equipment. The program includes three service tiers, allowing customers to choose the level of support and coverage that best fits their network — from trailer capacity access to full-service programs with compliance, maintenance and operational support. This tiered structure lets providers scale up or down as demand shifts, giving them flexibility while keeping costs predictable. Both offerings are powered by TrailerHawk.ai, Wabash’s platform that combines advanced technology, operational expertise and cargo assurance to manage trailer replenishment, staging, repositioning and utilization. Wabash announced the acquisition of TrailerHawk.ai earlier this year and is incorporating the technology into its TaaS offering to provide enhanced visibility and analytics to customers. “Our mission has always been to enable logistics providers to grow with flexible, scalable trailer solutions,” said Mike Pettit, chief growth officer at Wabash. “With TaaS Pools and TaaS Plus, we are taking another step forward in helping shippers, carriers and 3PLs overcome today’s supply chain challenges with confidence.” “Our customers think about trailers the same way they think about other procurement choices — with a focus on cost, assurance and flexibility. As a trailering company, we’re meeting that need with TaaS, giving them the same control without asset ownership,” said Brett Suma, managing director at Wabash. “By combining our equipment, FleetCare service network, and TrailerHawk.ai assurance technology, we’re making trailer access more efficient and more predictable across the supply chain.” By uniting physical assets, nationwide support and digital intelligence, Wabash is setting a new standard for trailer utilization and procurement. The TaaS portfolio reflects the company’s commitment to building scalable solutions that reduce waste, improve efficiency and strengthen supply chain resilience. Learn more at onewabash.com .
